messages:
leo-finance: Quick question - GCP settlement gcp-settle-2024-11 shows a 15% tax withholding line of -$3,150 on payout for reseller CP-61. We haven't seen withholding for this partner before. Anyone aware of a new tax req?
mina-partner-ops: Which jurisdiction is the settlement for? Withholding usually shows up for certain countries (BR, IN) or if partner didn't provide tax docs.
gcp-marketplace-bot: Notice: Settlement gcp-settle-2024-11 processed 2024-11-21T09:12Z. Withholding: 3150.00 USD. Order ref gcp-ord-6601. Docs: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/settlements/gcp-settle-2024-11 (login required).
leo-finance: Settlement is EU region but partner CP-61 (NordicChannel) is registered in Sweden. We typically do not see withholding for Sweden.
tara-ap: AP: If GCP withheld taxes from our payout, that reduces the cash we receive. We need to know whether this is refundable (to us) or withheld on behalf of the partner. Who files for reclaim?
kevin-tax: Likely scenario: GCP applied a tax treaty withholding because partner's tax_id was missing or flagged. Check partner VAT/VIES status and W-8/W-9 equivalents. If partner failed to provide docs, GCP may withhold and remit to local authority. We need the paperwork to reclaim, but usually the partner must reclaim, not the vendor.
sara-cust-success: Nordics partner said they uploaded VAT docs last month. I'll confirm with their portal. If GCP withheld despite docs, this is an AWS/GCP processing error.
mina-partner-ops: I'll ask the partner to re-check their portal and share screenshots. Also pinged GCP PM for rationale.
leo-finance: For the books: how do we record the withheld amount? Book as a reduction of settlement cash received (DR Cash short 1100 $3,150) and CR GCP Withholding Expense (or receivable) 1200? Need GL guidance.
kevin-tax: Treat as receivable from partner only if contract says we will be reimbursed. Otherwise reduce revenue for the period: DR GCP Withholding (contra-rev) 4005 $3,150, CR Accounts Receivable/Settlement 1102 $3,150. Tag as contingent reclaim if partner later provides docs. I'll draft memo.
tara-ap: AP will mark payout as short and hold any outbound payments to the partner until resolved.
mina-partner-ops: Partner confirmed they uploaded VAT docs on 2024-10-28 and attached submission screenshot. GCP PM replied: "Withholding applied due to pending tax-validation status on 2024-11-20; partner portal shows docs but status not updated. We will escalate and possibly reverse if validation completes."
leo-finance: Action items: (1) Kevin to draft memo/JE for provisional contra-revenue posting for Nov close; (2) Mina to follow up with GCP PM and request reverse/credit if validation completes; (3) Tara mark bank variance and hold partner payout if needed. I'll add to close notes and update when GCP responds. :thumbsup:
